O.outcome_detail: GMKT performance

cells.quote: In the SEM structure model, both BMI (β = -0.102) and working memory RT (β = -0.104) showed direct negative effects on GMKT performance (P < 0.05; Figs. 2, 3).
cells.note: Measured association in 1202 medical students; longer reaction time indicates slower working-memory performance, and no intervention or random assignment was used.
